title: Demonstrate Need
desc: Describe the problem you’re trying to solve or the reason your product needs to exist. Identify customer pain points by interviewing a sample group from your target market.

title: Envision Solutions
desc: Use customer feedback to brainstorm solutions. Assess your ideas based on constraints, such as time, cost, resources, and technology.

title: Define POC Goals
desc: What are you trying to achieve with your POC? Communicate with internal stakeholders to align goals.

title: Specify Success Criteria
desc: What metrics will you use to evaluate your idea? Define how to measure success.

title: Identify Team
desc: List the POC team members and their roles in the project.

title: Create a Timeline
desc: Estimate duration and key milestones for the POC execution.

title: Plan Next Steps
desc: Create a proposal for what happens if the POC is successful.
